questions.question: A, B and C are three students. A got 25 percent more marks than B and 10 percent less marks than C. If B got 324 marks, then what are the marks got by C ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A got 25% more marks than B.

A got 10% less marks than C.

B got 324 marks.

**Formula Used:**

A = B + 25% of B

A = C - 10% of C

**Calculation:**

From the given data:

B = 324 marks

A = 324 + (25/100) × 324

A = 324 + 81

⇒ A = 405 marks

A = C - (10/100) × C

⇒ 405 = C - 0.1C

⇒ 405 = 0.9C

⇒ C = 405 / 0.9

⇒ C = 450 marks

**The marks got by C are 450.**

questions.question: By increasing 250 by 40%, the value obtained is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial value = 250

Percentage increase = 40%

**Formula Used:**

New Value = Initial Value + (Initial Value × Percentage Increase)

**Calculation:**

Initial Value = 250

Percentage Increase = 40%

Convert percentage to decimal: 40% = 40/100 = 0.40

New Value = 250 + (250 × 0.40)

⇒ New Value = 250 + 100

⇒ New Value = 350

**The value obtained by increasing 250 by 40% is 350.**

In a company there are 42 employees. The average salary of 27 employees is Rs. 4100 per month and average salary of 13 employees is Rs. 6100 per month. If the average salary of all employees is Rs. 7200 per month, then what is the per month average salary of the remaining 2 employees?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total employees in the company = 42

Average salary of 27 employees = Rs. 4100 per month

Average salary of 13 employees = Rs. 6100 per month

Average salary of all employees = Rs. 7200 per month

Number of remaining employees = 42 - 27 - 13 = 2

**Formula Used:**

Average salary = Total salary / Number of employees

**Calculation:**

Total salary of 27 employees = 27 × 4100

⇒ Total salary of 27 employees = 110700

Total salary of 13 employees = 13 × 6100

⇒ Total salary of 13 employees = 79300

Total salary of all employees = 42 × 7200

⇒ Total salary of all employees = 302400

Total salary of remaining 2 employees = Total salary of all employees - Total salary of 27 employees - Total salary of 13 employees

⇒ Total salary of remaining 2 employees = 302400 - 110700 - 79300

⇒ Total salary of remaining 2 employees = 112400

Average salary of the remaining 2 employees = Total salary of remaining 2 employees / 2

⇒ Average salary of the remaining 2 employees = 112400 / 2

⇒ Average salary of the remaining 2 employees = 56200

**The per month average salary of the remaining 2 employees is Rs. 56200.**

questions.question: Few students standing in a row have weights of 85 kg, 86 kg, 53 kg, 65 kg, 78 kg, 93 kg, 75 kg and 73 kg. What is the average weight of those students?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weights of students: 85 kg, 86 kg, 53 kg, 65 kg, 78 kg, 93 kg, 75 kg, 73 kg.

**Formula Used:**

Average weight = (Sum of all weights) / (Number of students)

**Calculation:**

Sum of all weights = 85 + 86 + 53 + 65 + 78 + 93 + 75 + 73

Sum of all weights = 608 kg

Number of students = 8

Average weight = 608 / 8

⇒ Average weight = 76 kg

**The average weight of the students is 76 kg.**

questions.question: If Asha borrows Rs. 52000 from Lakshmi for a period of four years. What will be the rate of simple interest per annum if Asha has to pay an interest of Rs. 20800 at the end of four years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 52000

Time (T) = 4 years

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs. 20800

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Given, SI = Rs. 20800

⇒ 20800 = (52000 × R × 4) / 100

⇒ 20800 = 2080R

⇒ R = 20800 / 2080

⇒ R = 10

**The rate of simple interest per annum is 10%.**

questions.question: The ratio of three numbers is 6 : 7 : 8. If the sum of the three numbers is 420, then what is the smallest number among the three numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of three numbers is 6 : 7 : 8.

The sum of the three numbers is 420.

**Formula Used:**

Let the three numbers be 6x, 7x, and 8x.

Sum of the three numbers = 6x + 7x + 8x = 21x

**Calculation:**

Given sum of the three numbers = 420

⇒ 21x = 420

⇒ x = 420 / 21

⇒ x = 20

Smallest number = 6x = 6 × 20 = 120

**The smallest number among the three numbers is 120.**

questions.question: Four numbers are in the ratio of 7 : 5 : 3 : 2. Sum of these number is 68 . What will be the sum of the first and fourth number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Four numbers are in the ratio of 7 : 5 : 3 : 2.

Sum of these numbers = 68

**Formula Used:**

Sum of ratio parts = Sum of the numbers

Value of each part = Sum of the numbers / Sum of ratio parts

**Calculation:**

Sum of ratio parts = 7 + 5 + 3 + 2

Sum of ratio parts = 17

Value of each part = 68 / 17

⇒ Value of each part = 4

First number = 7 × 4 = 28

Fourth number = 2 × 4 = 8

Sum of the first and fourth number = 28 + 8

⇒ Sum of the first and fourth number = 36

**The sum of the first and fourth number is 36.**

questions.question: A wire of length 36 meters is cut into equal pieces, each measuring 4 meters. Determine the number of pieces.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total length of the wire = 36 meters

Length of each piece = 4 meters

**Formula Used:**

Number of pieces = Total length of the wire / Length of each piece

**Calculation:**

Number of pieces = 36 / 4

⇒ Number of pieces = 9

**The number of pieces is 9.**

questions.question: E alone can complete a work in 15 days. F and G together can complete the same work in 10 days. E, F and G together will complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

E alone can complete a work in 15 days.

F and G together can complete the same work in 10 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work Rate = Work / Time

Combined Work Rate of E, F, and G = Work Rate of E + Work Rate of F and G

Time = Work / Combined Work Rate

**Calculation:**

Work Rate of E = 1/15

Work Rate of F and G = 1/10

Combined Work Rate of E, F, and G = 1/15 + 1/10

⇒ Combined Work Rate = (1)/(15) + (1)/(10)

⇒ Combined Work Rate = (2)/(30) + (3)/(30)

⇒ Combined Work Rate = (5)/(30)

⇒ Combined Work Rate = (1)/(6)

Time = Work / Combined Work Rate

⇒ Time = 1 / (1/6)

⇒ Time = 6 days

**The correct answer is option 4, 6 days.**

questions.question: What is the value of 95 - 111 × 21 ÷ 3 + 44 × 6 ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 95 - 111 × 21 ÷ 3 + 44 × 6

**Formula Used:**

Follow the order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

First, perform the multiplication and division from left to right:

⇒ 95 - 111 × 21 ÷ 3 + 44 × 6

⇒ 95 - 2331 ÷ 3 + 44 × 6

⇒ 95 - 777 + 264

Next, perform the addition and subtraction from left to right:

⇒ 95 - 777 + 264

⇒ -682 + 264

⇒ -418

The value of the expression is -418.

questions.question: If 44 percent rate of compound interest compounded yearly is equivalent to the x percent rate of compound interest compounded half yearly, then what is the value of x ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest compounded yearly = 44%

Rate of interest compounded half-yearly = x%

**Formula used:**

For compound interest compounded yearly: A = P(1 + r/100)t

For compound interest compounded half-yearly: A = P(1 + x/100)²t

Since the two rates are equivalent, we equate the two formulas:

(1 + 44/100) = (1 + x/100)²

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Simplify the left-hand side:

1 + 44/100 = 1.44

Step 2: Equate and solve for x:

1.44 = (1 + x/100)²

Step 3: Take the square root of both sides:

√1.44 = 1 + x/100

1.2 = 1 + x/100

Step 4: Solve for x:

1.2 - 1 = x/100

0.2 = x/100

x = 0.2 × 100

x = 20

**∴ The value of x is 20%.**

questions.question: A dealer sold a sofa set at a profit of 39%. Had he sold it for Rs. 1565 less, he would have gained 29%. For what value should he sell it in order to gain 27% ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit at selling price = 39%

If sold for Rs. 1565 less, profit = 29%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit %/100)

**Calculation:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) be Rs. x.

Selling Price at 39% profit = 1.39x

Selling Price at 29% profit = 1.29x

Given, 1.39x - 1565 = 1.29x

⇒ 0.10x = 1565

⇒ x = 1565 / 0.10

⇒ x = 15650

To gain 27% profit, the selling price should be:

Selling Price at 27% profit = 15650 × 1.27

Selling Price at 27% profit = 19875.5

**The value he should sell it for to gain 27% is Rs. 19,875.5.**

questions.question: Pankaj is 40 percent less efficient than Rahul. If Rahul can make a computer in 16 days, then Pankaj can make the same computer in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pankaj is 40% less efficient than Rahul.

Rahul can make a computer in 16 days.

**Formula Used:**

Time taken by Pankaj = Time taken by Rahul × (1 + Efficiency reduction factor)

**Calculation:**

Efficiency reduction factor = 40% = 0.40

Efficiency of Rahul = 100%

Efficiency of Pankaj = 100% - 40% = 60% = 0.60

Time taken by Rahul = 16 days

Let TPₐₙₖₐj be the time taken by Pankaj.

Since Pankaj is 60% as efficient as Rahul, he will take more time to complete the same task.

Time taken by Pankaj is given by:

TPₐₙₖₐj = frac{TRₐₕᵤₗ}{EfficiencyPₐₙₖₐj}

⇒ 16/0.60 

⇒1600/60

⇒ 80/3

**The time taken by Pankaj to make the same computer is 80/3 days.**

questions.question: A dining table is listed at Rs. 1500 is sold to a retailer at successive discounts of 18% and 15% by the wholesaler. Then the cost price of the dining table for retailer is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Listed price of the dining table = Rs. 1500

First discount = 18%

Second discount = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Successive Discount Formula: Net Price = Original Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

**Calculation:**

Original Price = Rs. 1500

First Discount = 18% = 0.18

Second Discount = 15% = 0.15

Net Price = 1500 × (1 - 0.18) × (1 - 0.15)

Net Price = 1500 × 0.82 × 0.85

Net Price = 1500 × 0.697

Net Price = 1045.5

**The cost price of the dining table for the retailer is Rs. 1045.5.**

questions.question: Cost price of an article is Rs. 2500. If the loss percentage is 24 percent, then what is the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) = Rs. 2500

Loss percentage = 24%

**Formula Used:**

Loss = (Loss percentage × CP) / 100

Selling Price (SP) = CP - Loss

**Calculation:**

Loss = (24 × 2500) / 100

⇒ Loss = 600

Selling Price (SP) = 2500 - 600

⇒ SP = 1900

**The selling price of the article is Rs. 1900.**
